author: Hokuspokus
quote:
It's bad, like really bad.
The storyline is painfully bad written, feels like a Rom Com with nothing to it, from the outside looks like Watch Dogs and not GTA.
Lost everything that made GTA Grand Theft Auto, including actual Grand Theft Auto.
Graphics and physics engine are good, I have to give them that, but after 13 YEARS of waiting that is to be expected.
Not worth buying if not interested in a Sims/Watch Dogs mix.
Will refund and hopefully get my money back.
